items.title: Moderna Led the S&P 500 in August as Edison International Sank

items.title: Merck (MRK) Posts First Positive Phase 3 Result For Personalized mRNA Melanoma Therapy
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) and Moderna report the first positive Phase 3 results for an individualized mRNA neoantigen cancer therapy in melanoma patients. The therapy was tested in combination with Merck's immunotherapy KEYTRUDA in a Phase 3 trial setting. This marks the first time an mRNA-based individualized neoantigen approach has shown clinically meaningful and statistically significant Phase 3 data in cancer.
